You will hold near-executive authority over engineering delivery, operational resilience, organizational health, and budget across all divisions. What Success Looks Like (12–18 Months) Operational Excellence: A unified engineering cadence (OKRs, KPIs, delivery flow) is consistently adopted across divisions, enabling VPs to operate with high autonomy. Platform Modernization: The multi-year trading platform consolidation transitions successfully from design to MVP with clear improvements in latency and deployment velocity. Data Governance: A centralized, group-level data capability is live with a published catalog and cross-divisional SLAs. Regulatory & Cost Control: Engineering consistently hits all MiCA, DORA, and SOC 2 milestones while managing cloud and vendor spend against clear business-unit baselines. Key Responsibilities Engineering Delivery & Cadence: Run day-to-day global engineering operations. Own OKRs, monthly business reviews, and delivery pipelines. Deputize for the CTO with the Board, ExCo, and external partners. Platform Consolidation & Data Strategy: Lead the multi-year unification of The Company's trading infrastructure across 80+ venues and 1,400+ markets. Oversee the creation of shared group data pipelines and governance. Cybersecurity Execution & Compliance: Own the on-the-ground execution of The Company’s security and regulatory commitments (MiCA, DORA, SOC 2). Foster a "controls-by-design" engineering culture while respecting regulated divisional information walls. Talent, Budget & Scale: Manage the global engineering budget, vendor relationships, and M&A engineering integrations. Mentor divisional VPs, refine career frameworks, and scale the team across Europe and the US. Core Competencies Scale Operational Leadership: Proven ability to design and run engineering operating models (metrics, governance, delivery) for global teams. Technical Depth & Decision-Making: Comfortable challenging senior architects on system design and making decisive, firm-wide trade-offs under constraints. Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical risks, budgets, and timelines into crisp, actionable insights for ExCo and the Board. Regulatory Execution Fluency: Expert at translating high-level security strategies into practical, everyday engineering workflows and compliance outcomes. Key Experiences & Target Background Trading & Crypto Infrastructure: Substantial experience with low-latency distributed systems, algorithmic trading infrastructure, and digital assets (CEX/DEX market structure, custody, on-chain settlement). Familiarity with Rust is a strong plus. Multi-Division Scale & Consolidation: Proven track record running global engineering across multiple business lines, including executing large-scale platform consolidations and managing shared data/infra functions. Regulated Environments: Experience operating within strict regulatory frameworks (MiCA, DORA, SOC 2) and managing engineering across compliance-driven information walls. Operational #2 Profile: Prior experience as a trusted senior deputy or operational partner to a technical founder or CTO, taking true ownership of execution while strategy is held by the principal. Growth & M&A Integration: Experience scaling engineering organizations through rapid maturity phases and integrating acquired technical teams. What We Offer We recognize that elite engineering leadership requires a world-class environment. As a key executive, this is a highly influential role where you will drive our overarching technology strategy, shape the engineering culture, and have the direct ability to make major company decisions. To support your success, we offer a top-percentile compensation and benefits package designed for global leaders: Financial & Equity Competitive Base Salary: A highly attractive, top-market base salary reflective of elite engineering leadership in the proprietary trading and HFT space. Stock Option Plan: Significant equity participation, giving you a vested stake in the long-term success and growth of the firm. Performance Bonus: A highly lucrative, discretionary annual bonus structure tied directly to firm and individual impact. Workplace Flexibility & Tech Ultimate Working Flexibility: Choose the environment where you perform best, with fully remote, hybrid, or premium office-based options. Global Mobility: The seamless ability to travel to, work from, and collaborate across our international office hubs. Executive Tech Budget: A generous workplace and technology allowance to build a bespoke, ultra-high-end remote engineering and trading workstation. Health, Culture & Lifestyle Localized Statutory Care: Full statutory benefits, pension contributions, and leave entitlements tailored to maximize the standards of your country of residence. Global Offsites: Fully funded company offsites and leadership retreats to foster strategic alignment and innovation. Company Socials: Regular regional team events and socials to build deep relationships across our engineering and trading desks. Our Interview Process We respect your time and run a streamlined, transparent, and highly communicative hiring process. For this executive position, our process consists of: Initial Discovery: An introductory call with our Senior Talent Partner to discuss your background, the role's scope, and mutual alignment. Strategic & Technical Deep-Dive: A call with our CTO to discuss architectural philosophy, high-frequency infrastructure, and engineering leadership. Executive Alignment: A comprehensive meeting with our Chief Executive team to focus on business strategy, firm vision, and cultural fit. Presentation & Debrief: A final stage involving a presentation on a relevant technical or strategic topic, followed by an interactive debrief with our leadership. Offer: Extension of a highly competitive offer to join the executive team.

Assist with strategic campaign planning and help ensure alignment between internal priorities and external messaging. Uphold and apply brand standards across all materials, platforms, and communications. Help translate organizational goals and program initiatives into clear, compelling marketing materials and communication assets. Internal & External Communications Support internal communication efforts to keep staff, board members, and stakeholders informed and aligned. Review marketing and communications materials prior to release to ensure consistency with brand standards and organizational messaging. Content Creation & Marketing Materials Create and coordinate the development of internal and external marketing materials, including: Flyers and promotional materials Event collateral Reports, presentations, infographics, and one-pagers Digital and print assets Help maintain and manage a content calendar to ensure timely production and distribution of materials across all channels . Impact Storytelling & Community Visibility Support the development of compelling narratives that communicate Omega CDC's mission, programs, and community impact. Help identify opportunities to enhance storytelling, community engagement, and organizational visibility across digital and print platforms. Digital Presence & Performance Tracking Manage Omega CDC's digital platforms, including website updates, email marketing, and social media channels, in coordination with the external agency and under the Director's direction. Track and analyze communication metrics to measure performance and inform future content strategy. Help support the adoption and implementation of digital tools, AI, and emerging technologies that strengthen communications, workflow efficiency, and storytelling capacity. Cross-Departmental & Initiative Support Collaborate with internal teams and community partners to ensure unified messaging across programs and initiatives. Develop key messaging frameworks and communication resources that clearly articulate program impact and community outcomes. Support organization-wide initiatives, events, campaigns, and key announcements by providing communications and marketing coordination. Assist in maintaining organization-wide communications calendars and engagement activities to promote cross-departmental collaboration. Demonstrated experience or a strong portfolio in communications, content development, graphic design, and tactical marketing. Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences and platforms. Experience managing social media platforms and developing engaging content that supports organizational goals. Experience with digital marketing tools, email marketing platforms, website content management systems, and performance analytics. Proficiency with design and content-creation tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite. Strong organizational and project-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple assignments, priorities, and deadlines. Ability to collaborate effectively with staff, community members, partners, vendors, funders, and other stakeholders. Experience in nonprofit, community-based, or mission-driven marketing and communications preferred. Ability to translate organizational data and program outcomes into clear, engaging, and accessible stories. Familiarity with artificial intelligence and emerging digital tools, including their responsible use to support content development, communications, and workflow efficiency. Knowledge of Northwest Dayton or experience communicating with diverse communities is preferred. Photography, videography, or basic video-editing experience is a plus. Physical Demands and Work Environment Work is performed primarily in an office environment. Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times. Requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards. This position requires successful completion of an employment screening BCI/ FBI background check.

Monogram Health is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and on holidays, to support and treat patients in their home. Monogram Health’s personalized and innovative treatment model is proven to dramatically improve patient outcomes and quality of life while reducing medical costs across the health care continuum.
